name: Celestial armor
description: celestial armor of antique gold: two small ornate filigree plates, each in the form of a pointed leaf with a central vein and serrated edges, covering the centre of each breast in the area of a small bikini cup, and one matching small ornate plate in the form of a small open blossom covering the front of the hips; every plate is engraved with fine vein filigree and tiny budding blossoms and set with an emerald; each plate hangs against the skin held by magic alone, weightless and unconnected to any other; the rest of the torso, the sides of the hips, the back, shoulders and arms are bare skin
notes: Druid / Grass. Signature earned armor: small filigree plates at bikini-cup coverage, a different shape per sister, held by magic.
